name: Fuego
title: Freedom Fighter
description: A fiery luchador in red mask, fighting for freedom with flamboyant style and unbreakable spirit.
greeting_variants: *flexes* FUEGO! The Flame of Freedom! At your service!
You face oppression? You face FUEGO!
*poses dramatically* The mask chooses the hero! And this mask? CHOSE FUEGO!
Vex plans. Boulder guards. FUEGO FIGHTS!
*shadow boxes* Every punch for justice! Every kick for hope!
The Void fears nothing? FUEGO will teach it fear!
*pointing at you* You have the heart of a luchador! I see it!
Three falls mean nothing when freedom is on the line!

dialog_tree.text: FUEGO! Once champion of the ring! Now champion of the PEOPLE! The Void took my arena, my fans, my world! But it cannot take FUEGO'S SPIRIT!

options.text: How do you fight the Void?

dialog_tree.text: *strikes pose* Enthusiasm is FUEGO'S FUEL! When people see FUEGO, they see that WE WILL NOT FALL! That the fight continues! That HOPE LIVES!

party_reactions.garret: Now THIS is my kind of energy!
party_reactions.fuego: *high fives Garret* YOU understand! SPIRIT BROTHERS!

dialog_tree.text: The Void is strong! But FUEGO is STRONGER! It attacks the mind? FUEGO has IRON WILL! It warps reality? FUEGO has UNBREAKABLE SPIRIT! Every time it pushes, FUEGO PUSHES BACK!
*eyes shine* A TAG TEAM PARTNER?! FUEGO has waited for this! Together we will be UNSTOPPABLE! The Void will TREMBLE! The people will CHEER!

mini_quest.title: The Liberation Match
mini_quest.description: Help Fuego liberate a captured supply cache by defeating the void-touched guardian in a dramatic showdown.
objectives: Meet Fuego at the captured warehouse
Defeat the Void Champion in combat

ambient_barks: The people need heroes! FUEGO provides!
*shadow boxing* One two! One two! FOR JUSTICE!
Mask never comes off! Secret identity! Important!
*to child* You! Small one! You have fighting spirit! Train hard!
The Void picked the WRONG world to invade!
*flexing for refugees* See? Strong! We are ALL strong!

cross_zone_references.ember: The Ember has luchadors too! FUEGO will visit! Exchange techniques!
cross_zone_references.chroma_tower: A gold sumo in the Tower! Worthy opponent! FUEGO dreams of this match!
cross_zone_references.palace: The old arena... FUEGO fought there. Greatest match of life. Before.

garret.response: GARRET! The sly fox! Together we are DYNAMIC DUO!

kael.response: CAPTAIN! Your discipline! FUEGO respects! But needs more FLAIR!

time_of_day.day: Training, posing for refugees, boosting morale
time_of_day.night: Night raids on Void positions, patrols

world_state_triggers.battle_join: Dramatic entrance: 'DID SOMEONE CALL FOR A HERO?!'
world_state_triggers.victory: Celebration pose: 'ANOTHER VICTORY FOR THE FORCES OF GOOD!'
